title: Revision finds relationships between meanings
meaning: Releasing inadequate foundations can reveal actual grounds for your shared view and bring harmony between different aspects of the material.
text: Harmony can appear after a simple but unstable picture is released. The Tower in the physical position of Ajna suggests jointly examining its inadequate foundation. The Tower in energy supports seeking understanding’s actual grounds. Temperance in emotions feels relationships between different aspects. Releasing a familiar account may be difficult. Action removes an insufficient version while wanting real foundations preserves the possibility of seeing connections between parts for both people.

Suppose you explained a composition’s beauty solely through symmetry. Comparing a favourite asymmetrical drawing, you stop treating this measure as sufficient. **Revision can reveal harmony beyond a familiar structure.** Seeking actual grounds reveals relationships between size, empty space and directions. Harmony gains understandable material. You can explain how different parts balance attention while personal responses remain. Your view acquires a connection discussable through a particular drawing. It need not follow one feature in advance to remain substantially coherent and accessible to both people considering it together.

The risk is immediately replacing symmetry with another single structure to secure harmony. Seeking actual grounds preserves relationships’ variety. This drawing showed another way to organise attention. Your view stays clear when harmony concerns noticed parts while another example may alter the account without declaring the earlier observation mistaken or defending it against every future difference.
